categories_thin: Independent hotels/inns: none found - the only inn-like listings in town (Metuchen Inn, Brown Stone) are restaurants, which are excluded
Manufacturing and wholesale: found 17 addresses, but almost all come from one bulk directory with no website or phone, so verification will be heavy
Lumber/building-supply and garden centers: only Boro Ace Hardware; the Sherwin-Williams and Home Depot in the area are chains and excluded
Security-system installers: only third-party service-area pages (Certified Protection Systems in Edison, Maffey's) plus Lock Sharp US; no Metuchen-based alarm company surfaced
caveats: Google Maps returned a 'limited view' of about 10-12 results per query, so map coverage is not exhaustive; results also drift into Edison, Fords and Colonia, so only Metuchen street addresses were kept

Several Metuchen yards share one address (913 Middlesex Ave hosts Bulldog Auto, Raymond's, Wizard Auto Body and Satch Cycles; 99 Middlesex Ave hosts Beacon Hill and B & H; 10 Liberty St hosts Auto Motion and Jeff's Auto Body) - these may be related or the same operator
Businesses marked 'one bulk directory only' (mostly manufacturers on Liberty St / Durham Ave and the wear-house addresses) come from NJ Business Directory and need confirmation they still operate

Excluded as chains/franchises or out of scope: AAMCO, Mavis/Suburban Discount Tire, Mobil, Banfield Pet Hospital, Woof Gang Bakery & Grooming, Kumon, Everbrook Academy, Supercuts, Massage Envy, Sherwin-Williams, The UPS Store, Storage Sense, Extra Space Storage, MaidPro, YMCA child care, TRC Environmental (large consultancy), Metuchen Savings Bank, Metuchen Borough Public Works

Group A items surfaced during the sweep (Arch2 architects, Cornerstone Environmental, Systech IT, Clinical Staffing, Berkshire Hathaway Metuchen, insurance agencies) were left out because the brief covers groups C and D only
data_gaps: Overpass/OpenStreetMap API unreachable (fetch failed / aborted) - no OSM cross-check possible

Yellow Pages, Superpages, BBB, ChamberofCommerce.com and Angi all returned HTTP 403 or Cloudflare challenges, so their Metuchen category pages could not be read directly; entries from them rely on search-result citations of those URLs
Metuchen Area Chamber of Commerce site (Square) is JavaScript-only and could not be read, so its member list was not harvested

Downtown Metuchen 'Shopping' category only rendered 6 businesses including on a /page/2/ request, so the retail list is likely incomplete; the SMALL_BUSINESS_2026 update of downtown retailers is not captured
Street addresses found only on Google Maps without a town label (Dirtbusters, Hello Maid, Sierra's Gifts, Chamber 43) are assumed Metuchen from the search geography and should be confirmed

Several businesses advertise a Metuchen service area without a confirmed Metuchen street address (Moosewood Tree Service, Lock Sharp US, Strongmile Movers, Always Affordable Moving, Don Coleman Painting, Jersey Pro Painters, Cislo Siding, Innovative Exteriors, John Muho USA) - these may be home-based operators
